test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Clench
solution: The correct answer is '**Relax**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Clench**' is '**Relax**'. • **Clench**: to close or hold tightly. (बाँधना या जकड़ना, भींचना) • *Example: She **clenched** her fists and looked as if she was going to hit him.* • **Relax**: to become or make somebody/something become less hard or tight. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का तनावमुक्त या शिथिल होना, उसे तनावमुक्त या शिथिल करना) • *Example: Don’t **relax** your grip on the rope!* **Correct Answer:__** *Tighten.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Tighten**: to become or to make something tight or tighter. (कसना या कस जाना या किसी वस्‍तु को कस देना) • **Hold**: to take somebody/something and keep him/her/it in your hand, etc. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को थामे रहना) • **Clasp**: an object, usually of metal, which fastens or holds something together. (बाँधने या मज़बूती से पकड़ने की सामान्‍यतः धातु की वस्‍तु) 16d:Tb1c, The correct answer is '**Dignified**'.
